Sam (Sales): HelixCorp SecOps asked if we can explicitly exclude analytics pipelines and long-term backups from the POC ISO scope. Quick guidance?
Lina (Security): Yes, we can provide an applicability statement for a constrained PoC. Need: clear boundary, permitted data types, retention limits, signed risk acceptance.
Sam (Sales): Also asking whether that changes pricing between Dedicated vs Private POC. Ravi?
Ravi (AE): Pricing unchanged by scope alone. If they want extra controls (HSM/KMS integration, extended audit retention, customized logging/redaction) those are billable.
Marie (HelixSec): We need a short doc mapping PoC activities to ISO clauses (A.9, A.12 etc), plus an evidence checklist (cert copy, policy owners, contact). Also confirm token/secret redaction and that backups can be disabled.
Nora (Solutions): Technically doable: private VPC, backups off, logging retention configurable. We can provide sample config + screenshots of KMS settings. Sample we usually send:
```
deployment:
  mode: private
  vpc_id: vpc-helix-01
  backups.enabled: false
  logging:
    retention_days: 5
    redact_patterns: ["api_key","token"]
```
Lina (Security): We will not allow full exclusion of operational audit logs — minimum retention 5 days for traceability. I'll add a compensating control section (ephemeral keys, periodic audit sampling).
Marie (HelixSec): 5 days works for the PoC. Please explicitly state in the applicability statement which ISMS policies are not applied during the PoC.
Lina (Security): Will do: list out-of-scope controls and reference our policy documents (Access Control Policy, Encryption Standard, Backup Policy). Add a signature block for customer risk acceptance.
infra-bot: deploy request queued: helix-poc-001. infra ETA ~72h after "approved-by" tag.
Sam (Sales): Next steps: Lina posts draft applicability + clause map by EOD, Nora uploads runbook/config, Ravi flags any add-on pricing. Marie to confirm signer/email.
Marie (HelixSec): I'll be the signer (marie@helix.example). Send draft to me when ready. :white_check_mark:
Nora (Solutions): I'll attach KMS screenshot and a minimal runbook after Lina posts the doc.
Lina (Security): Drafting now, will post in ~2 hours. It will be one page + 1 table mapping clauses.
Sam (Sales): Thanks — we'll loop back after the draft.
